note: The coastal and home set in kit/catalog/assets/coastal/: models made by export_coastal.gd, measured by coastal.py record. Never edit by hand.

models.name: palm tree
models.description: A coconut palm 6.4 m tall: a ringed trunk curving away from the wind, nine drooping fronds folded along their midribs and a bunch of four coconuts under the crown. Sways in the shared wind.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_coastal.gd (an internal task, iamar-creator-ux: the beach-house brief)

models.name: dock
models.description: A wooden dock 2 m wide and 9 m long on eight piles: weathered deck boards with gaps, stringers, a ladder down into the water at the far end and two mooring cleats. The origin is the water's surface at the shore end; the deck is 0.6 m above it and runs out along -Z, so place it at the water's height with the origin on the beach and turn it to face the sea. Walk on it with "collision": "mesh".
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_coastal.gd (an internal task, iamar-creator-ux: the beach-house brief)

models.name: beach umbrella
models.description: A beach umbrella 2.4 m tall: a white pole pushed 0.35 m into the sand, an eight-panel canopy 2.3 m across in alternating teal and off-white with a scalloped valance, and ribs underneath.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_coastal.gd (an internal task, iamar-creator-ux: the beach-house brief)

models.name: sun lounger
models.description: A teak sun lounger 1.95 m long: four legs, slatted bed, a backrest raised at 40 degrees at the +Z end and a striped cream and teal cushion pad. Pair it with the beach umbrella and towel.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_coastal.gd (an internal task, iamar-creator-ux: the beach-house brief)

models.name: beach towel
models.description: A striped beach towel 1.7 x 0.85 m laid flat on the sand in red, yellow, teal and off-white bands, one corner folded back. Flat (1 cm), so it needs no collision.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_coastal.gd (an internal task, iamar-creator-ux: the beach-house brief)

models.name: sea shells
models.description: A scatter of sea shells over about 1 x 0.8 m: four scallops, three whelks, three clams and an orange starfish, lying on the sand at the tide line. Scatter a few copies along the shore, turned differently.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_coastal.gd (an internal task, iamar-creator-ux: the beach-house brief)

models.name: coral cluster
models.description: A coral cluster 1.4 m across on a reef rock: a yellow brain coral dome, pink and orange staghorn coral, a purple sea fan and three orange tube sponges. The origin is the sea floor: place it under clear water, where fish swim over it.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_coastal.gd (an internal task, iamar-creator-ux: the beach-house brief)

models.name: kelp
models.description: A bed of giant kelp: eight olive-brown blades 1.4 to 2.6 m tall rising from a rocky holdfast, waving in the swell (clip sway, each blade out of phase). The origin is the sea floor: place it under water at least 2 m deep.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_coastal.gd (an internal task, iamar-creator-ux: the beach-house brief)

models.name: sofa
models.description: A modern three-seat sofa 2.1 m wide with the seat at 0.45 m: slate-blue upholstery, three seat and three back cushions, rolled arms, walnut legs and a cream scatter cushion. It faces +Z; put its back (-Z) to a wall or behind a rug in a living room.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_coastal.gd (an internal task, iamar-creator-ux: the beach-house brief)

models.name: kitchen counter
models.description: A fitted kitchen counter 2.4 m long and 0.9 m high: sage-green base cabinets with doors and a drawer row, a pale stone worktop, an inset steel sink with a swan-neck tap, a black four-ring hob and a tiled splashback. Doors face +Z; put the back (-Z) against a wall.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_coastal.gd (an internal task, iamar-creator-ux: the beach-house brief)

models.name: bathtub
models.description: A freestanding bath 1.7 x 0.78 m: an off-white enamel shell with a rolled rim and a deep basin, a walnut plinth and a chrome mixer tap at the +X end. Put it in a bathroom with its long side to a wall.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_coastal.gd (an internal task, iamar-creator-ux: the beach-house brief)

models.name: wardrobe
models.description: A double wardrobe 1.2 m wide, 0.6 m deep and 2.1 m tall in light oak: two doors with a shadow gap, long steel bar handles, a plinth and a top cornice. Doors face +Z; stand its back (-Z) against a bedroom wall.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_coastal.gd (an internal task, iamar-creator-ux: the beach-house brief)

models.name: rug
models.description: A woven rug 2.4 x 1.7 m: a red field with a central blue and gold medallion, a cream inner border, a deep blue outer border and a fringe at both short ends. Flat (1 cm), so it needs no collision; lay it under a sofa or beside a bed.
models.cite: made for the kit by kit/catalog/assets/export_coastal.gd (an internal task, iamar-creator-ux: the beach-house brief)
